defects.toCents truncates: toCents uses Math.floor, so float prices like 19.99 become 1998 cents instead of 1999.
defects.formatCents negative: formatCents mangles negative amounts: -50 cents becomes '0.-50 EUR' (sign lost, minus inside the cents).
defects.discount arguments swapped: applyDiscount's parameters were swapped to (percent, cents) but orders.js still calls applyDiscount(subtotalCents, percent), producing wrong (even negative) totals.
defects.stack cap uses max: stackedPercent uses Math.max instead of Math.min, so every order gets at least a 50% discount.
defects.reserve refuses last unit: reserve's check is available <= qty, so ordering exactly the remaining stock is refused.
defects.reserve returns null: reserve now returns null instead of throwing OutOfStock, and orders.js only catches the exception, so out-of-stock orders proceed and get charged.
defects.release no-op on Map: release iterates Object.entries(reservation), but the reservation is a Map, so nothing is released after a failed payment.
defects.free shipping at exactly 100: Free shipping uses >= 10000, but the spec says strictly above 100.00 EUR.
defects.free shipping field mismatch: shippingCents reads order.subtotal, but orders.js passes discountedCents, so the free-shipping branch never fires.
defects.retry skips an attempt: retry's loop starts at attempt = 1, so it makes one fewer try (and tries: 1 makes no call and throws undefined).
defects.retry option renamed: retry's delayMs option became delaySeconds, but payments.js still passes delayMs: 2000, which is ignored, so the provider backoff drops to the 0.1 s default.
defects.non-retryable retried: retry no longer rethrows non-retryable errors, so failures such as declined charges are retried.
defects.topSkus ascending: topSkus now sorts ascending, returning the least sold SKUs instead of the top ones.
defects.average of empty is NaN: average dropped the empty-array guard, so it returns NaN instead of 0.

decoys.decoy isExpired: isExpired's switch to comparing coupon.expires with today's ISO date string changes which coupons count as expired.
decoys.decoy splitEvenly: splitEvenly's rewrite changes the shares it returns or how the remainder is distributed.
decoys.decoy shipping bands: The shipping band lookup (Object.freeze, BANDS.find) changes the fee for some weight or the too-heavy error.
decoys.decoy dailyRevenue: dailyRevenue's switch to a Map, ?? 0 and Object.fromEntries changes its result.
